title: StrategySet
description: The candidates shown in Slack Message 2 (HAR-129 section 6, 14): generated from one account state, complete and evaluated before the message is posted. Immutable once written; choosing never changes it.

state_ref.description: The one state every candidate was generated from.

no_acceptable_candidate.description: True when every candidate is blocked by a failed blocking eval or restricted by the transition policy (HAR-128), after one regeneration under an open transition. Ghost then recommends none: ranking 1 only orders the display and preferred_by_agent on it is the ordering anchor the preference record compares against, never a recommendation; surfaces must say that no candidate is recommended and the human decides unaided. False otherwise.

candidates.description: Exactly 3 for the demo path (HAR-129 section 6); the limit is a property of the demo, not of the model, and a later contract version may widen it. Rankings are 1, 2 and 3 and exactly one candidate is preferred (the one ranked 1).
